audit_items.proof_trace: The monotonicity invariant is enforced by two complementary mechanisms: (1) the arithmetic formula in `reserve::accrue_interest` computes `new = borrow_index_prior * (1 + simple_interest_factor)`, where `simple_interest_factor >= 0` because `Decimal` is unsigned (u256-backed) — so `new >= prior` algebraically; (2) `set_value` (L25) has a hard abort `assert!(self.value.le(value), ...)` that prevents any decrement from being committed. The only write path to `borrow_index` is `set_value`, which is `public(package)` and only called from `reserve::accrue_interest`.
